stemMd: A circle has radius 10. A chord lies 6 units from its centre. What is the chord's length?
explanationMd: A perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord. Half the chord is the square root of 10 squared−6 squared=8, so the full chord is 16.

distractorRationale.d: This is the diameter, not the off-centre chord.
distractorRationale.a: This is only half the chord.
distractorRationale.e: This doubles the full chord again.
distractorRationale.b: This doubles the centre-to-chord distance instead of the half-chord.
